purpose: Manual benchmark scaffold for evaluating deterministic Software Engineer recommendations before adding more ranking complexity.
notes: These cases are AI-assisted drafts reviewed for file structure, catalog consistency, tag validity, and obvious recommendation-rule issues.
The project owner has reviewed these draft cases as acceptable for initial local benchmarking.
Do not treat labels as expert ground truth until an adviser, lecturer, TA, senior student, or another trusted reviewer approves them.
Keep cases stable so old and new recommender versions can be compared on the same inputs.
The frontend does not read this file. It is for offline evaluation planning and later tooling.
